# Anlogic HX4S20 UDP reference subset

These files are copied unchanged from the official `33_HX4S20_Etherent_test_01_02_final_1000` example in `DEMO_TD版本6.2.1.zip`.

Only the TEMAC/RGMII/clock/UDP-stack files needed by the independent MAIN-5A Ethernet diagnostic are retained. The museum media project does not depend on this directory.
